text:
Type: dark solid wood wall shelf
Use: displaying books, ceramics and photos; living room, dining room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: black-brown stained solid wood shelf, black-brown wooden brackets with a diagonal brace
Colors: dark black-brown, deep espresso
Shape: long thick-edged plank resting on two angular wooden brackets, visible wood grain, simple sturdy outline, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, solid, homely, calm
Goes with: white or sage walls, warm wood, linen, brass or ceramic accents; farmhouse, traditional or Scandinavian rooms
